identity.title: Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios (graphic novel)

leadText: (Japanese: 水の都の護神ラティアスとラティオス Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios) is a graphic novel published by Shogakukan in Japan. It is a manga-style book (often branded as "Animation Comics" or "Ani-Manga") which retells the plotlines of Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias and Camp Pikachu using screenshots from both films. The book credits Hideki Sonoda and Takeshi Shudō as the authors.
